summary: Pono Capital Four (SPAC) filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Merger Agreement with Blackstar Orbital Technologies, an aerospace company. Parent will domesticate to Delaware, then its merger sub will merge with Blackstar. Board unanimously approved and recommends shareholder approval. The filing provides no financial terms (price per share, valuation, premium) or advisor names. The deal is a SPAC business combination, subject to shareholder approvals and customary closing conditions. Watch for definitive proxy/prospectus with deal valuation, redemption levels, and regulatory clearances; risk-arb centers on PONO share price vs. implied post-merger value.
